newsitem.title: USA: Comcast wins option to acquire E! - Journal.
newsitem.headline: Comcast wins option to acquire E! - Journal.

text.p: Comcast Corp won the option to acquire Time Warner's 58 percent stake in E! Entertainment Television for about $310 million, The Wall Street Journal reported Friday, citing sources familiar with the situation.
The Journal said Time Warner's partners, including Comcast, recently triggered a buy-sell provision tied to a December deadline in the original partnership accord.
The story said Comcast emerged from the accord with the option to buy Time Warner's stake, sell to Time Warner through proxy the other 42 percent or leave ownership as it was.
